name: Notion, List
description: Rows from any Notion database, one line each: title, status, date, person, and a progress bar where your database tracks one. Auto-detects which columns hold status, progress, date and person, so it works on your schema without configuration. Sort by any column. Supports several Notion accounts. Requires the Notion Core plugin.

cell_options.name: data_source
cell_options.label: Database
cell_options.help: Every database your Notion accounts can see, prefixed by account name when more than one is configured. Picking one also selects that account: a Notion database belongs to exactly one workspace, so there is nothing else to choose. Nothing listed? Open the database in Notion, then ••• → Connections → add your integration.

cell_options.name: show_completed
cell_options.label: Include completed rows
cell_options.help: Off by default: a row whose status is Done (or whose done checkbox is ticked) is left out. Turn on to list everything.

cell_options.name: sort_prop
cell_options.label: Sort by column (blank = default order)
cell_options.help: Type a Notion column name exactly. Blank keeps the built-in order: overdue first, then by date, then by progress. Rows with nothing in the column go last.

cell_options.name: sort2_prop
cell_options.label: Then sort by column (blank = none)
cell_options.help: Breaks ties in the first sort. Type a Notion column name exactly.

cell_options.name: filter_person
cell_options.label: Only show items for
cell_options.help: Leave blank to show everything. Type 'me' for whoever owns the Notion token (exact, and filtered by Notion itself), or a person's name as it appears in Notion.

cell_options.name: filter_columns
cell_options.label: Filter columns (blank = the people column)
cell_options.help: Comma-separated Notion column names, e.g. 'Assignee, Collaborators'. A row is kept if ANY of them matches. Blank uses the auto-detected people column. The Notion Core admin page's Inspect columns link lists the exact names.

cell_options.name: status_prop
cell_options.label: Status column (blank = auto-detect)
cell_options.help: Only needed if auto-detection picks the wrong column. Type the Notion property name exactly. The Notion Core admin page lists every column and what was detected.

cell_options.name: progress_prop
cell_options.label: Progress column (blank = auto-detect)
cell_options.help: A number, formula or rollup. Percent-formatted values (0-1) and whole percentages (0-100) are both understood.

cell_options.name: person_prop
cell_options.label: Person column (blank = auto-detect)
cell_options.help: A people column. Also the default column for 'Only show items for'.
